# Yahya Quran Academy

> A children's Quran site in Arabic and English: the full Uthmani text with
> verified teaching recitations, illustrated stories from the Quran, and the
> Seerah of the Prophet Muhammad told for ages 6-11. Most pages are available
> in both languages at the same URL; append ?lang=en for English. The supplied
> Companions stories are Arabic-only pending reviewed translation.

Non-commercial and educational.

## Listening
- [Listening](https://yahyaquran.com/listen): the complete murattal mushaf recited by
  Muhammad Siddiq al-Minshawi, about 28 hours of audio, one page per surah at
  https://yahyaquran.com/listen/1 through https://yahyaquran.com/listen/114. Playback only — no account,
  no tracking.

## Mushafi
- [Mushafi](https://yahyaquran.com/mushafi): a page-image reader for the printed mushaf —
  colored Tajweed rules, Hafs 'an Aasim narration, Uthmani script. Each of the
  604 pages (https://yahyaquran.com/mushafi/1 through https://yahyaquran.com/mushafi/604) is the scanned
  page itself, not re-typeset text. Page jump, a surah index, zoom, and a
  locally-saved last position; no account.

## Memorization journey
- [The journey](https://yahyaquran.com/hifz): a map for memorizing al-Fatiha and Juz Amma,
  with the Uthmani text of each surah in it. The child listens to an ayah,
  repeats it, records their own voice and declares it memorized; it then
  returns for review after one, three, seven, fourteen and thirty days. No
  automated mastery score — the parent judges the recitation — and every
  record stays in the browser on the child's own device.

## Stories from the Quran
- [Animals in the Quran — حيوانات في القرآن](https://yahyaquran.com/stories/animals): 8 stories. Eight stories about animals the Quran names, and what they teach.
- [Women in the Quran — نساء في القرآن](https://yahyaquran.com/stories/women): 8 stories. Inspiring examples of patience, faith, and wisdom from Quranic stories.
- [Stories of the Prophets — قصص الأنبياء](https://yahyaquran.com/stories/prophets): 17 stories. Seventeen stories from Adam to Muhammad.
- [People and Nations — شخصيات وأمم](https://yahyaquran.com/stories/nations): 9 stories. Nine stories about the nations and figures the Quran names, and what became of them.

## Creed, for children
- [The Journey Begins — مدخل الرحلة](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah#opening): 1 cards. بطاقة تفتح الرحلة: لماذا نتعلّم عن الله، وما الذي ينتظرنا في الأبواب الخمسة.
- [Knowing My Lord — أعرف ربي](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah#knowing-allah): 6 cards. ست بطاقات نتعرّف فيها على الله: خلقه لنا، ووحدانيته، وعلمه بنا، ورزقه، ورحمته، ومحبتنا له.
- [The Pillars of Faith — أركان الإيمان](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah#pillars-of-faith): 6 cards. ست بطاقات في أركان الإيمان: بالله، وملائكته، وكتبه، ورسله، واليوم الآخر، والقدر.
- [The Messengers, and Muhammad ﷺ — رسل الله ومحمد ﷺ](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah#messengers): 4 cards. أربع بطاقات: لماذا أرسل الله الرسل، ومن هو محمد ﷺ، ولماذا نحبه، وكيف نقتدي به.
- [Worshipping Allah — أعبد الله](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah#worship): 6 cards. ست بطاقات في العبادة العملية: الصلاة، والدعاء، والقرآن، والذكر، والصيام، والشكر.
- [Faith You Can See — إيماني في أفعالي](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah#faith-in-action): 8 cards. ثماني بطاقات يظهر فيها الإيمان في السلوك: الصدق، والأمانة، وحسن الخلق، والرحمة، وبر الوالدين، والمساعدة، والعفو، والرفق بالحيوان.
- [The Journey Ends — ختام الرحلة](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah#closing): 1 cards. بطاقة تجمع الرحلة كلها، ومعها تحدٍّ لأسبوع كامل.

- [رحلة: أعرف ربي](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/knowing-my-lord): كلّما عرفتُ ربّي أكثر، أحببتُه أكثر.
- [الله خلقني](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/allah-created-me): أنا نعمة من نِعَم الله، فأشكره وأتأمّل صنعه.
- [الله واحد](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/allah-is-one): أعبد الله وحده، ولا أجعل له شريكًا.
- [الله يراني ويسمعني ويعلم كل شيء](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/allah-sees-and-hears): أراقب الله في سرّي وعلانيتي.
- [الله يرزقني وينعم عليّ](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/allah-provides): أعرف نعمة الله، فأشكره ولا أبطر.
- [الله رحيم ويحب المحسنين](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/allah-is-merciful): أرجو رحمة الله، وأحسن إلى خلقه.
- [أنا أحب الله وأعبده](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/i-love-and-worship-allah): أحب الله، فأطيعه وأفعل ما يحب.
- [أؤمن بالله](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/belief-in-allah): أؤمن بالله وحده، وأطمئن أنه ربي وخالقي.
- [عالم الملائكة](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/the-angels): أؤمن بالملائكة، وأحب الطاعة مثلما يحبها عباد الله المكرمون.
- [كتب الله](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/the-books): أؤمن بكتب الله، وأتمسّك بالقرآن المحفوظ.
- [رسل الله](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/the-messengers): أؤمن برسل الله جميعًا، وأعلم أنهم دعوا إلى عبادة الله.
- [ماذا بعد الموت؟](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/the-last-day): أعمل الخير اليوم، وأرجو لقاء الله برحمته.
- [كل شيء بحساب (الإيمان بالقدر)](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/belief-in-destiny): أجتهد وأختار الخير، وأتوكل على الله بحكمة وصبر.
- [لماذا أرسل الله الأنبياء؟](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/why-prophets-were-sent): أحمد الله أن أرسل الرسل ليعلّمونا الطريق إليه.
- [من هو محمد ﷺ؟](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/who-is-muhammad): أؤمن أن محمدًا ﷺ رسول الله وخاتم النبيين.
- [لماذا نحب النبي ﷺ؟](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/why-we-love-the-prophet): أحب النبي ﷺ لأنه رسول الله وعلّمني الخير.
- [كيف نقتدي بالنبي ﷺ؟](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/following-the-prophet): أقتدي بالنبي ﷺ في صدقي ورحمتي وحسن خلقي.
- [الصلاة](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/the-prayer): أحافظ على صلاتي لأنها صلتي بربي.
- [الدعاء](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/supplication): أدعو الله بقلب صادق في كل وقت.
- [القرآن](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/the-quran): أحب القرآن، وأقرأه باحترام لأهتدي به.
- [الذكر](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/remembrance): أذكر الله بلساني وقلبي، فيطمئن قلبي.
- [الصيام](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/fasting): أتعلّم من الصيام الصبر والشكر ومساعدة الآخرين.
- [الشكر](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/gratitude): أشكر الله بالكلام والعمل، وأستخدم نعمه في الخير.
- [الصدق](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/truthfulness): أقول الحقيقة لأن الله يحب الصادقين.
- [الأمانة](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/trustworthiness): أحفظ الأمانة، فالله يعلم ما أفعل.
- [حسن الخلق](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/good-character): أتكلم بلطف، وأجعل خلقي دليلًا على إيماني.
- [الرحمة](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/mercy): أرحم من حولي، وأحب أن أكون من أهل المرحمة.
- [بر الوالدين](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/honouring-parents): أبرّ والديّ بالكلمة الطيبة والمساعدة والطاعة في الخير.
- [مساعدة الآخرين](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/helping-others): أساعد غيري ابتغاء رضا الله، وأفرح بالخير.
- [العفو](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/forgiveness): أعفو عندما أقدر، وأطلب الإصلاح لا الانتقام.
- [الرفق بالحيوان](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/kindness-to-animals): أرفق بالحيوان لأنه خلق من خلق الله.
- [خريطتي الإيمانية](https://yahyaquran.com/aqeedah/my-map-of-faith): عرفتُ ربّي، فأحببتُه، فأطعتُه، فظهر ذلك في أفعالي.

## Companions — Arabic stories
- [أبو بكر الصديق رضي الله عنه — الصديق الذي لم يترك صاحبه](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/abu-bakr)

- [عثمان بن عفان رضي الله عنه — عندما احتاج المسلمون إلى مصحف يجمعهم](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/uthman)
- [علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه — الراية في خيبر](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/ali)
- [خديجة بنت خويلد رضي الله عنها — أول من طمأنه عندما عاد من الغار](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/khadijah)
- [عائشة بنت أبي بكر رضي الله عنها — عندما أنزل الله براءتها قرآنًا](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/aishah)
- [حمزة بن عبد المطلب رضي الله عنه — الأسد الذي استشهد في أُحد](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/hamzah)
- [بلال بن رباح رضي الله عنه — صوت خطوات سُمع في الجنة](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/bilal)
- [خالد بن الوليد رضي الله عنه — عندما وصلت الراية إلى خالد](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/khalid)
- [أبو هريرة رضي الله عنه — لماذا حفظ كل هذه الأحاديث؟](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/abu-hurayrah)
- [سلمان الفارسي رضي الله عنه — عندما قال النبي ﷺ: «صدق سلمان»](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/salman)
- [سعد بن أبي وقاص رضي الله عنه — «ارمِ سعد»](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/saad)
- [عبد الرحمن بن عوف رضي الله عنه — «دلوني على السوق»](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/abd-al-rahman)
- [طلحة بن عبيد الله رضي الله عنه — يوم وقف يحمي رسول الله ﷺ](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/talhah)
- [الزبير بن العوام رضي الله عنه — حواريُّ رسول الله ﷺ](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/al-zubayr)
- [أبو عبيدة عامر بن الجراح رضي الله عنه — أمين هذه الأمة](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/abu-ubaydah)
- [عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه — عندما طلب النبي ﷺ أن يسمع القرآن منه](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/ibn-masud)
- [عبد الله بن عباس رضي الله عنهما — دعوة غيّرت حياة طفل](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/ibn-abbas)
- [معاذ بن جبل رضي الله عنه — المهمة التي بدأت بالتوحيد](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/muadh)
- [زيد بن ثابت رضي الله عنه — المهمة التي كانت أثقل من جبل](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/zayd-ibn-thabit)
- [زيد بن حارثة رضي الله عنه — الصحابي الذي ذكره القرآن باسمه](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/zayd-ibn-harithah)
- [أسامة بن زيد رضي الله عنهما — هل تستطيع أن تعرف ما في قلب إنسان؟](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/usamah)
- [أنس بن مالك رضي الله عنه — عشر سنوات... بلا كلمة تضجر](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/anas)
- [عمار بن ياسر رضي الله عنهما — كان يحمل أكثر من الآخرين](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/ammar)
- [مصعب بن عمير رضي الله عنه — لم يجدوا ما يكفي لتغطية جسده](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/musab)
- [أسماء بنت أبي بكر رضي الله عنها — عندما صنعت حزامين من حزام واحد](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/asma)
- [جعفر بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه — القائد الثاني في مؤتة](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/jafar)
- [الحسن بن علي رضي الله عنهما — طفل على كتف النبي ﷺ... ثم رجل يصلح بين جيشين](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/al-hasan)
- [الحسين بن علي رضي الله عنهما — نحبه أولًا كما أحبه رسول الله ﷺ](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/al-husayn)
- [أُبيّ بن كعب رضي الله عنه — عندما أخبره النبي ﷺ أن الله ذكر اسمه](https://yahyaquran.com/companions/ubayy)
Sources and adult editorial notes accompany each story; technical publication is not scholarly approval.

## Seerah of the Prophet
- [Beginnings — Seeds of Light](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah#station-1): 5 stories. Five stories from the childhood of the Prophet (pbuh): his birth, his years in the desert, the love of his grandfather and uncle, and the first work of his life.
- [The Truthful, The Trustworthy](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah#station-2): 5 stories. Five stories from his youth before the revelation: his honesty in trade, his home with Khadijah, his wisdom over the Black Stone, his stand with the wronged, and his retreats to the cave of Hira.
- [The Revelation](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah#station-3): 5 stories. Five stories from the beginning of the revelation: the first meeting in Cave Hira, what Waraqah ibn Nawfal said, the pause and Surah Ad-Duha, the call to rise in Surah Al-Muddaththir, and the forms the revelation took.
- [The Call: In Secret, Then Aloud](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah#station-4): 10 stories. Ten stories from the years of the call in Mecca: Dar al-Arqam, the call from Safa, the patience of Bilal and the family of Yasir, the migration to Abyssinia, the siege and the Year of Sorrow, the Islam of Hamza and Umar, his answer to the offer of wealth and kingship, the splitting of the moon, the story of at-Tufayl, and the journey to Taif.
- [The Night Journey and the Ascension](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah#station-5): 15 stories. Fifteen stories from a single night: from the Sacred Mosque to al-Aqsa, then an ascent through the seven heavens and the prophets met in each, to Sidrat al-Muntaha, the gift of the prayer, and the return — and the morning that followed.
- [The Migration to Madinah](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah#station-6): 15 stories. Fifteen stories from the migration: the plot at Dar an-Nadwa, Ali in the bed, Abu Bakr’s tears, Asma’s belt and Amir’s flock, then Cave Thawr and the tranquillity, the expert guide, Umm Ma’bad’s tent, Suraqah’s horse, Buraydah’s banner, the mosque of Quba, the house of Abu Ayyub, and the day Yathrib became the city of light.
- [Defending the Homeland](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah#station-7): 15 stories. Fifteen stories from the years of defending Madinah: the permission after thirteen years of patience, Badr with its counsel and its angels, captives who became teachers, the lesson of Uhud, Salman's trench, the wind that scattered the Confederates, the treaty of Hudaybiyyah, the letters to kings, Khaybar, and finally the conquest of Mecca — the day of mercy and the general pardon.
- [The Year of Delegations, and a State at Peace](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah#station-8): 15 stories. Fifteen stories from the settled years: the lesson of Hunayn about pride in numbers, the Army of Hardship and those who wept at having nothing to give, Tabuk that ended in treaties rather than battle, then the Year of Delegations, the talks with Najran and the counsel to Mu'adh — and the charter of the community: the people of the Bench, kindness to animals, honesty in the market, and the mosque as a school for everyone.
- [The Farewell Pilgrimage, and the End of the Message](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah#station-9): 15 stories. Fifteen stories from the last year: a march to Mecca in two white cloths, the standing at Arafat, and a sermon saying no Arab is above a non-Arab except by piety — then farewell to the martyrs, a commander of eighteen, an illness in which fairness was still kept, the last prayer, the last glance, the last testament, and what remained after him.


### Beginnings — Seeds of Light
- [The Day Mecca Shone — عام الفيل ومولد النبي ﷺ](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/birth-of-light): القرآن الكريم: سورة الفيل 105:1–5. سجل المصدر الأصلي `st-1-01`: سيرة ابن هشام ومراجع السيرة.
- [The Pure Desert Breeze — في بادية بني سعد](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/desert-breeze): سجل المصدر الأصلي `st-1-02`: الرحيق المختوم ومراجع السيرة.
- [In the Shade of the Kaaba — بعد فقد الأم](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/grandfather-love): القرآن الكريم: سورة الضحى 93:6 و93:9. سجل المصدر الأصلي `st-1-03`: سيرة ابن هشام وزاد المعاد.
- [The Kind Uncle's House — في كفالة أبي طالب](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/uncle-home): سجل المصدر الأصلي `st-1-04`: الطبقات الكبرى لابن سعد ومراجع السيرة. القرآن الكريم: سورة الضحى 93:6 كتأمل في معنى الإيواء.
- [The Shepherd — راعي الغنم](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/little-shepherd): صحيح البخاري 2262، كتاب الإجارة، حديث أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه.

### The Truthful, The Trustworthy
- [The Honest Merchant of Mecca — تاجر مكة الأمين](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/the-honest-merchant): سجل المصدر الأصلي `st-2-01`: السيرة النبوية لابن هشام.
- [The Righteous Wife Khadijah — خديجة رضي الله عنها](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/khadijah): صحيح مسلم 2430. سجل المصدر الأصلي `st-2-02`: صحيح البخاري وسيرة ابن هشام.
- [The Wisdom of the Black Stone — حكمة الحجر الأسود](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/the-black-stone): سجل المصدر الأصلي `st-2-03`: مسند أحمد وسيرة ابن هشام.
- [Helping the Oppressed — نصرة المظلوم](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/hilf-al-fudul): سجل المصدر الأصلي `st-2-04`: سنن البيهقي ومراجع السيرة.
- [Solitude and Reflection — الخلوة في غار حراء](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/cave-of-hira): صحيح البخاري، كتاب بدء الوحي، حديث عائشة رضي الله عنها.

### The Revelation
- [The First Light: Cave Hira and the Word Iqra — أول الوحي: اقرأ](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/revelation-iqra): القرآن الكريم: سورة العلق 96:1–5. صحيح البخاري، كتاب بدء الوحي، حديث عائشة رضي الله عنها.
- [Waraqah ibn Nawfal: The Great Secret — ورقة بن نوفل](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/revelation-waraqah): صحيح البخاري، كتاب بدء الوحي، حديث عائشة رضي الله عنها.
- [The Pause of Revelation and Surah Ad-Duha — سورة الضحى](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/revelation-pause): القرآن الكريم: سورة الضحى 93:1–11. سجل المصدر الأصلي `st-3-03`: سورة الضحى وصحيح البخاري.
- [O You Wrapped in Garments: Arise and Warn — يا أيها المدثر: قم فأنذر](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/revelation-muddaththir): القرآن الكريم: سورة المدثر 74:1–3. صحيح البخاري، كتاب بدء الوحي.
- [How Did the Revelation Come? — كيف كان ينزل الوحي؟](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/revelation-forms): القرآن الكريم: سورة المزمل 73:5. صحيح البخاري، كتاب بدء الوحي.

### The Call: In Secret, Then Aloud
- [The Great Secret and Dar al-Arqam — دار الأرقم](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/dar-al-arqam): سجل المصدر الأصلي `st-4-01`: سيرة ابن هشام والطبقات الكبرى لابن سعد.
- [Mount Safa and the Great Call — نداء جبل الصفا](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/mount-safa-call): القرآن الكريم: سورة المسد. صحيح البخاري، خبر النداء على الصفا.
- [Heroes Who Never Give Up: Bilal and the Family of Yasir — الثبات على الإيمان](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/heroes-of-patience): سجل المصدر الأصلي `st-4-03`: سيرة ابن هشام وصحيح البخاري.
- [Journey to the Land of the Just King — الهجرة إلى أرض الملك العادل](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/migration-to-abyssinia): سجل المصدر الأصلي `st-4-04`: مسند أحمد وسيرة ابن هشام.
- [The Unjust Siege and the Year of Sorrow — الحصار وعام الحزن](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/year-of-sorrow): سجل المصدر الأصلي `st-4-05`: سيرة ابن هشام.
- [The Islam of Heroes: Hamza and Umar — إسلام حمزة وعمر رضي الله عنهما](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/islam-of-heroes): سجل المصدر الأصلي `st-4-06`: سيرة ابن هشام والطبقات الكبرى لابن سعد.
- [The Sun in My Right Hand, the Moon in My Left — الثبات على الدعوة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/sun-and-moon): سجل المصدر الأصلي `st-4-07`: سيرة ابن هشام.
- [A Miracle in the Sky: The Splitting of the Moon — انشقاق القمر](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/splitting-of-the-moon): القرآن الكريم: سورة القمر 54:1. صحيح البخاري وصحيح مسلم.
- [Cotton in the Ears: The Clever Poet — القصيدة التي سمعت الحق](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/cotton-in-ears): سجل المصدر الأصلي `st-4-09`: سيرة ابن هشام.
- [The Sad Journey to Taif — رحلة الطائف](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/journey-to-taif): صحيح البخاري وصحيح مسلم، حديث عائشة رضي الله عنها في الطائف.

### The Night Journey and the Ascension
- [Preparing the Leader: The Opening of the Chest — بداية ليلة الإسراء](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/chest-washing-zamzam): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، أحاديث الإسراء والمعراج.
- [Al-Buraq: Swifter Than Sight — البراق في طريق الإسراء](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/the-amazing-buraq): صحيح مسلم، حديث الإسراء ووصف البراق.
- [The Road to Jerusalem — إلى المسجد الأقصى](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/road-to-jerusalem): القرآن الكريم: سورة الإسراء 17:1. بعض تفاصيل الطريق في كتب السيرة تحتاج مراجعة منفصلة.
- [Leading the Prophets at al-Aqsa — إمام الأنبياء في المسجد الأقصى](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/leader-of-prophets): صحيح مسلم، حديث الإسراء.
- [The First Heaven: Meeting Adam — السماء الأولى: آدم عليه السلام](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/the-first-heaven-adam): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، حديث المعراج.
- [The Second Heaven: The Cousins — السماء الثانية: عيسى ويحيى عليهما السلام](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/second-heaven-isa-yahya): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، حديث المعراج.
- [The Third Heaven: Half of All Beauty — السماء الثالثة: يوسف عليه السلام](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/third-heaven-yusuf): صحيح مسلم، حديث المعراج. القرآن الكريم: سورة يوسف.
- [The Fourth Heaven: A High Place — السماء الرابعة: إدريس عليه السلام](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/fourth-heaven-idris): القرآن الكريم: سورة مريم 19:56–57. صحيح البخاري ومسلم، حديث المعراج.
- [The Fifth Heaven: The Beloved Prophet — السماء الخامسة: هارون عليه السلام](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/fifth-heaven-harun): القرآن الكريم: سورة مريم 19:53. صحيح البخاري ومسلم، حديث المعراج.
- [The Sixth Heaven: The Tear of Musa — السماء السادسة: موسى عليه السلام](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/sixth-heaven-musa): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، حديث فرض الصلاة ليلة المعراج.
- [The Seventh Heaven: Ibrahim's Greeting to Us — السماء السابعة: إبراهيم عليه السلام](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/seventh-heaven-ibrahim): صحيح البخاري، حديث المعراج والبيت المعمور. القرآن الكريم: سورة البقرة 2:127.
- [Sidrat al-Muntaha: Where Everything Stops — سدرة المنتهى](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/sidrat-al-muntaha): القرآن الكريم: سورة النجم 53:13–18. صحيح البخاري ومسلم، حديث المعراج.
- [The Great Gift: The Prayer — الهدية الكبرى: الصلاة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/the-great-gift-prayer): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، حديث فرض الصلاة ليلة المعراج.
- [Musa's Advice: Five in Deed, Fifty in Reward — خمس في العمل وخمسون في الأجر](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/musa-advice-reduction): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، حديث فرض الصلاة ليلة المعراج.
- [The Morning of Certainty, and the Name as-Siddiq — صباح اليقين](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/morning-of-certainty): صحيح البخاري، خبر وصف بيت المقدس. تلقيب أبي بكر بالصدّيق في كتب السيرة.

### The Migration to Madinah
- [The Plot at Dar an-Nadwa and a Handful of Dust — قرار الهجرة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/dar-al-nadwa-dust): القرآن الكريم: سورة الأنفال 8:30. تفاصيل حفنة التراب وتلاوة يس ليست ضمن سرد الطفل لضعف توثيقها.
- [The Hero in the Bed — الأمانة في ليلة الهجرة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/hero-in-the-bed): سيرة ابن هشام، خبر مبيت علي رضي الله عنه ورد الأمانات.
- [Tears of Joy: “May I Accompany You?” — الصُّحبة في طريق الهجرة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/tears-of-joy-companion): صحيح البخاري، حديث عائشة رضي الله عنها في الهجرة.
- [Asma, She of the Two Belts — أسماء ذات النطاقين](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/asma-that-al-nitaqayn): صحيح البخاري، خبر أسماء ذات النطاقين.
- [The Shepherd Who Erased the Tracks — الراعي في الغار](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/smart-shepherd-footprints): صحيح البخاري، حديث عائشة رضي الله عنها في الهجرة.
- [Cave Thawr, and a Friend Who Went In First — غار ثور والاستعداد](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/cave-thawr-preparation): القرآن الكريم: سورة التوبة 9:40. صحيح البخاري، حديث الهجرة.
- [Fragile Threads, and Soldiers You Cannot See — السكينة في الغار](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/spider-and-dove): القرآن الكريم: سورة التوبة 9:40. صحيح البخاري، حديث الهجرة.
- [Do Not Grieve — Allah Is With Us — دليل خبير](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/do-not-be-sad): صحيح البخاري، حديث الهجرة.
- [An Expert Guide Who Was Not a Muslim — خيمة أم معبد](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/expert-guide): المستدرك للحاكم، ودلائل النبوة للبيهقي؛ خبر مشهور يحتاج تحققًا تفصيليًا.
- [Umm Ma'bad's Tent, and a Sheep With No Milk — سراقة والطريق الآمن](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/umm-mabad-tent): صحيح البخاري، حديث الهجرة.
- [A Hundred Camels, and a Horse That Sank — بريدة وراية السلام](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/suraqa-and-hundred-camels): طبقات ابن سعد، ودلائل النبوة للبيهقي؛ تفاصيل اللقاء تحتاج مراجعة.
- [Buraydah, and a Turban That Became a Banner — قباء وأول مسجد](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/buraida-white-banner): القرآن الكريم: سورة التوبة 9:108. صحيح البخاري ومسلم، خبر قباء.
- [Quba, and the First Mosque Built — بيت أبي أيوب](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/quba-first-mosque): صحيح البخاري، خبر نزول النبي ﷺ عند أبي أيوب.
- [Al-Qaswa, and the House of Abu Ayyub — المدينة تستقبل المهاجر](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/commanded-camel-qaswa): صحيح البخاري، خبر فرح أهل المدينة كما يرويه أنس رضي الله عنه. أنشودة «طلع البدر علينا» مشهورة وتحتاج مراجعة سندية.
- [Yathrib Becomes the City of Light — يثرب تصير المدينة المنوّرة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/talaa-al-badru): صحيح البخاري، أخبار الهجرة وبداية المدينة. تفاصيل بعض الأناشيد والعبارات الشائعة ليست جزءًا من السرد الموثق.

### Defending the Homeland
- [Why Did the Muslims Defend Themselves? — الإذن بالدفاع](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/permission-to-defend): القرآن الكريم: سورة الحج 22:39.
- [The Well of Badr and the Strength of Counsel — بئر بدر وقوة الشورى](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/badr-shura-counsel): القرآن الكريم: سورة آل عمران 3:159. سيرة ابن هشام؛ تفصيل مشورة الحباب يحتاج مراجعة سندية.
- [Badr and the Soldiers of the Sky — بدر ونصر الله](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/angels-in-badr): القرآن الكريم: سورة آل عمران 3:123–125. صحيح مسلم، حديث دعاء النبي ﷺ في بدر.
- [The Captives of Badr, Who Taught the Children — الرحمة بالأسرى](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/mercy-to-captives): القرآن الكريم: سورة الإنسان 76:8. خبر الفداء بالتعليم من مسند أحمد وكتب السيرة ويحتاج مراجعة.
- [The Archers' Hill and the Order — جبل الرماة والوصية](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/mount-of-archers-uhud): صحيح البخاري، خبر الرماة يوم أُحد.
- [The Lesson of Uhud, and Nusaybah — درس أُحد](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/tough-lesson-and-heroine): صحيح البخاري، خبر أُحد. خبر نسيبة في مسند أحمد وطبقات ابن سعد.
- [Ten Thousand, and the Idea of a Trench — فكرة الخندق](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/trench-salman-idea): القرآن الكريم: سورة الأحزاب 33:9–27. سيرة ابن هشام، خبر مشورة سلمان يحتاج مراجعة سندية.
- [The Leader's Pickaxe, and Food That Did Not Run Out — القائد يعمل مع فريقه](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/prophet-work-and-food-miracle): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، حديث جابر في الخندق.
- [The Wind of Victory, and the End of the Confederates — ريح النصر](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/cold-wind-victory-without-swords): القرآن الكريم: سورة الأحزاب 33:9. صحيح مسلم، خبر رحيل الأحزاب.
- [Hudaybiyyah: Peace in the Clothes of Pilgrimage — صلح الحديبية](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/hudaybiyyah-peace-treaty): صحيح البخاري، خبر الحديبية. القرآن الكريم: سورة الفتح 48:1.
- [Letters to the Kings of the Earth — رسائل تدعو إلى الخير](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/letters-to-world-leaders): صحيح البخاري، كتاب النبي ﷺ إلى هرقل.
- [The Forts of Khaybar and the Bearer of the Banner — راية خيبر](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/battle-of-khaybar-hero-ali): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، حديث الراية في خيبر.
- [Ten Thousand Fires in One Night — دخول مكة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/makkah-march-ten-thousand-fires): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، أخبار فتح مكة. تفصيل النيران في سيرة ابن هشام يحتاج مراجعة.
- [Today Is a Day of Mercy — اليوم يوم المرحمة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/day-of-mercy-entry): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، أخبار فتح مكة. القرآن الكريم: سورة الإسراء 17:81.
- [Go — You Are Free — عفو يفتح بداية جديدة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/go-you-are-free): سيرة ابن هشام والسنن الكبرى للبيهقي؛ عبارة الطلقاء مشهورة وتحتاج توثيقًا منفصلًا.

### The Year of Delegations, and a State at Peace
- [The Lesson of Hunayn: Pride in Numbers — حُنين: لا نغتر بالعدد](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/hunayn-pride-in-numbers): القرآن الكريم: سورة التوبة 9:25. صحيح البخاري.
- [The Leader Who Did Not Move — ثبات القائد](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/steadfast-leader-hunayn): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، خبر حنين.
- [The Army of Hardship, and a Race to Give — جيش العسرة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/army-of-hardship-tabuk): القرآن الكريم: سورة التوبة 9:117. روايات التبرعات في السنن تحتاج تفصيلًا في المراجعة.
- [Those Who Wept, and the Man Saved by Telling the Truth — نجاة الصادقين](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/weepers-and-true-repentance): القرآن الكريم: سورة التوبة 9:118. صحيح البخاري ومسلم، قصة كعب بن مالك.
- [The Camp at Tabuk: A Victory With No Blood — تبوك: قوة بلا قتال](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/tabuk-peace-without-bloodshed): صحيح البخاري ومسلم في أصل غزوة تبوك. تفاصيل المصالحات في كتب السيرة.
- [The Year of Delegations: Arabia Meets at the Mosque — عام الوفود](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/year-of-delegations-tamim): القرآن الكريم: سورة النصر 110:2. تفاصيل وفد بني تميم في كتب السيرة.
- [The Delegation of Najran: Guests in the Mosque — ضيوف نجران](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/delegation-of-najran-dialogue): سيرة ابن هشام؛ خبر وفد نجران يحتاج مراجعة تفصيلية. صحيح البخاري في فضل أبي عبيدة.
- [The Envoy to Yemen: Make It Easy — معاذ إلى اليمن](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/muadh-ambassador-to-yemen): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، حديث بعث معاذ إلى اليمن.
- [Dhimad and Ka'b: The Power of a Word — قوة الكلمة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/dhimad-and-kab-poetry): صحيح مسلم، حديث ضماد. خبر كعب بن زهير في كتب السيرة والأدب.
- [Stones Fall, Minds Are Freed — قلوب تتحرر من الأصنام](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/breaking-idols-building-hearts): القرآن الكريم: سورة الأعراف 7:194. تفاصيل البعوث إلى الأصنام في كتب السيرة.
- [The People of the Bench: The Poorest and the Closest — أهل الصفة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/mercy-to-the-weak-suffah): صحيح البخاري، أخبار أهل الصفة وأبي هريرة.
- [The Bird Whose Chicks Were Taken — الرحمة بالحيوان](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/kindness-to-animals-nature): سنن أبي داود، حديث الحُمَّرة. صحيح البخاري ومسلم: في كل كبد رطبة أجر.
- [A Hand in the Grain: Whoever Cheats Is Not of Us — من غش فليس منا](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/honest-merchant-market-ethics): صحيح مسلم، حديث صبرة الطعام: من غش فليس مني.
- [The Mosque as a School — and a Day for the Women — المسجد مدرسة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/mosque-school-and-knowledge): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، خبر تعليم النساء.
- [Madinah at Peace: From Sana'a to Hadramawt — المدينة تطمئن](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/madinah-capital-of-light): صحيح البخاري، حديث خباب بن الأرت.

### The Farewell Pilgrimage, and the End of the Message
- [The Great Call: A March to Mecca — النداء الأكبر: مسيرة إلى مكة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/grand-call-to-hajj): صحيح مسلم، حديث جابر رضي الله عنه في صفة حج النبي ﷺ. القرآن الكريم: سورة الحج 22:27.
- [Arafat: A Sea of White — عرفات: بحر من البياض](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/arafat-unity-and-equality): صحيح مسلم، حديث جابر رضي الله عنه في صفة الحج. سنن الترمذي: «الحج عرفة». القرآن الكريم: سورة البقرة 2:198.
- [The Farewell Sermon: No Arab Is Above a Non-Arab — خطبة الوداع: لا فضل لعربي على أعجمي](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/farewell-sermon-human-rights): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، في خطبة حجة الوداع وحرمة الدماء والأموال والأعراض. ألفاظ بعض جمل خطبة الوداع تجمع من طرق متعددة وتحتاج ضبطًا عند النقل المطول.
- [Take Good Care of the Women — استوصوا بالنساء خيرًا](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/testament-of-women-rights): صحيح البخاري ومسلم: الوصية بالنساء.
- [Have I Delivered It? And the Tears of Abu Bakr — ألا هل بلّغت؟ وبكاء الصديق](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/completion-of-faith-farewell): القرآن الكريم: سورة المائدة 5:3. صحيح البخاري ومسلم، في خطبة الوداع وحديث عمر رضي الله عنه.
- [Farewell to the Martyrs, and a Word from the Pulpit — وداع الشهداء وخطبة المنبر](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/signs-of-farewell-uhud-cemetery): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، في الصلاة على شهداء أُحد ومعاني الوفاء لهم. تحديد ترتيب بعض زيارات أُحد في آخر السيرة يحتاج مراجعة زمنية.
- [Usamah: A Commander at Eighteen — أسامة: قائد في الثامنة عشرة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/usama-young-army-commander): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، في إمارة أسامة بن زيد رضي الله عنهما.
- [The Illness Begins: Where Am I Tomorrow? — بداية المرض: أين أنا غدًا؟](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/fever-and-aisha-chamber): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، حديث عائشة رضي الله عنها في مرض النبي ﷺ.
- [Tell Abu Bakr to Lead the Prayer — مُروا أبا بكر فليصلِّ بالناس](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/abu-bakr-leads-prayer): صحيح البخاري ومسلم: أمر النبي ﷺ أبا بكر أن يصلي بالناس.
- [The Last Prayer He Prayed Among Them — آخر صلاة صلّاها بينهم](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/last-prayer-behind-abu-bakr): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، أخبار صلاة أبي بكر ومرض النبي ﷺ.
- [The Curtain Lifts, and the Smile — الستارة تُرفع.. والابتسامة](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/final-glance-and-smile): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، حديث أنس رضي الله عنه في كشف الستر.
- [The Prayer, the Prayer — and Those in Your Care — الصلاة الصلاة.. وما ملكت أيمانكم](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/last-testament-prayer-and-weak): سنن أبي داود وابن ماجه، في الوصية بالصلاة والإحسان؛ تحتاج ألفاظ الرواية وتخريجها مراجعة عند العرض المطول.
- [Rather, the Highest Companion — بل الرفيق الأعلى](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/to-the-highest-companion): صحيح البخاري ومسلم، حديث عائشة رضي الله عنها في وفاة النبي ﷺ.
- [Madinah Shakes, and Abu Bakr Holds — زلزال المدينة وثبات الصدّيق](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/city-earthquake-abu-bakr-speech): القرآن الكريم: سورة آل عمران 3:144. صحيح البخاري، خطبة أبي بكر رضي الله عنه يوم وفاة النبي ﷺ.
- [What Remained After Him: The Light Did Not Go Out — ما بقي بعده: النور لا ينطفئ](https://yahyaquran.com/seerah/eternal-legacy-living-sunnah): القرآن الكريم: سورة الأنبياء 21:107. صحيح البخاري، في موضع دفنه ﷺ وما ترك عند وفاته.

## In the Realm of the Quran
- [One Surah without it, one with two](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/bismillah): Surah At-Tawbah is the only surah that does not open with “Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Rahim”. Surah An-Naml has two: one at its beginning, and one inside the story of Prophet Sulaiman.
- [Egypt in the Quran](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/egypt): The name “Misr” — Egypt — is named outright in the Quran five times. One of them welcomes Prophet Yaqub and his family as they arrive.
- [Fifteen places to prostrate](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/sajdah): The mushaf we read marks fifteen places where a reader prostrates — the prostrations of recitation. Surah Al-Hajj stands out: it has two of them.
- [Surahs named after times of day](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/times): Some surahs are named after moments of the day, a reminder of how much time matters: Al-Fajr (dawn), Ad-Duha (morning), Al-Layl (night), and Al-Asr, which opens with a great oath.
- [The sun, the moon and the star](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/cosmos): The Quran is full of the great things in the sky — whole surahs carry their names: The Sun, The Moon, and The Star.
- [Clever birds with real work to do](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/birds): The Quran names birds that did important work: the crow that taught the first human, and the hoopoe that discovered the Kingdom of Sheba.
- [Metals and precious stones](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/minerals): The Quran names metals and stones we still use today: gold, silver, iron, pearls and coral.
- [What the people of Paradise wear](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/paradise-clothes): The Quran tells us the people of Paradise wear the finest cloth there is: silk, sundus and istabraq.
- [Colours in the Quran](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/colours): The Quran names many colours: white, black, red, green, blue and yellow — as in the story of the remarkable cow.
- [The first revealed, and among the last](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/first-and-last): The first thing revealed of the Quran commanded learning and reading. Among the last to come down is a verse reminding us of the return to Allah — and scholars report more than one answer for which was truly last.
- [The longest surah and the shortest](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/longest-shortest): The longest surah in the Quran is Al-Baqarah. The shortest is Al-Kawthar — just three verses.
- [One word, and it means gentleness](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/middle-word): When the young men of the cave sent one of them to buy food, they gave him a single instruction: walyatalattaf — let him be gentle. Gentle in what he says, how he walks, how he deals with people, so that no harm comes to him or from him.
- [The surah that names Allah in every verse](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/al-mujadilah): Surah Al-Mujadilah is the only surah in which the name of Allah appears in every single verse.
- [A challenge no one could meet](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/the-challenge): Allah challenged humans and jinn together to bring a book like the Quran — or even one surah like it. They never could.
- [Three hundred years, and nine](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/cave-years): The Quran gives the sleep of the People of the Cave with striking precision: three hundred solar years, which is exactly 309 lunar years.
- [A third of the Quran in four verses](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/al-ikhlas): Reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas, short as it is, carries the reward of a third of the Quran — because it is about who Allah is.
- [The surah that speaks for its reader](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/al-mulk): Surah Al-Mulk is only thirty verses, and it intercedes for the one who reads it on the Day of Judgement.
- [The one story told all at once](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/yusuf-complete): The story of Prophet Yusuf is the only one in the Quran told from beginning to end inside a single surah.
- [Animals in the Quran](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/animals): The Quran names many animals — among them the wolf, the dog and horses. The wolf appears in the story of Yusuf, in what his brothers claimed.
- [The plant that shaded Yunus](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/yaqteen): The Quran names the yaqteen — the gourd plant Allah grew to shelter Prophet Yunus after he came out of the whale.
- [The letters that open a surah](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/muqattaat): Twenty-nine surahs open with letters called al-muqatta'at, like Alif-Lam-Mim. They are a challenge: the Quran is built from the very letters people speak with, and still no one can produce its like.
- [Five surahs that open with praise](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/alhamdulillah): Five surahs open with “Alhamdulillah”: Al-Fatihah, Al-An'am, Al-Kahf, Saba' and Fatir — teaching us to thank Allah first.
- [Five surahs that begin with “Say”](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/qul): Five surahs begin with the word “Qul” — Say: Al-Jinn, Al-Kafirun, Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas.
- [Six surahs named after prophets](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/prophet-surahs): Six surahs carry a prophet's name: Yunus, Hud, Yusuf, Ibrahim, Muhammad and Nuh.
- [Vegetables the Quran names](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/vegetables): The Quran names vegetables still on our tables: onions, garlic, lentils and cucumbers — in the story of the Children of Israel.
- [The only one named by his nickname](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/abu-lahab): Of all those who opposed the Prophet ﷺ, only Abu Lahab is named in the Quran by his nickname — and Surah Al-Masad foretold his end while he was still alive.
- [Angels named outright](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/angels): A few angels are named outright in the Quran: Jibril, Mikail and Malik.
- [Two words, the same count](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/dunya-akhirah): The word “dunya” — this world — and the word “akhirah” — the hereafter — appear in the Quran the same number of times: 115 each, something some who have tracked the Quran's wording have noticed.
- [A book Allah promised to keep](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/preserved): The Quran is the one book Allah promised to preserve from any change, until the Day of Judgement.
- [The best things to drink](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/drinks): The Quran names the best drinks there are: water, milk, and honey — in which there is healing for people.
- [Cities the Quran names](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/holy-cities): The Quran calls Mecca “Bakkah”, and names Medina by the name it carried before — “Yathrib”.
- [The books that came before](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/earlier-books): The Quran names the revelations that came before it: the Torah, the Injeel, the Zabur, and the scriptures of Ibrahim and Musa.
- [Big lessons from small insects](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/insects): The Quran draws its lessons from the smallest creatures there are — the fly and the mosquito among them.
- [The greatest verse in the Quran](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/ayat-al-kursi): The greatest verse in the Quran is Ayat al-Kursi, in Surah Al-Baqarah. Whoever reads it is kept safe by it.
- [What to say before you read](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/isti-adha): Before opening the Quran we are told to seek refuge in Allah from the outcast Satan.
- [Nations from long ago](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/ancient-nations): The Quran names nations from the deep past: 'Aad, Thamud, and Gog and Magog.
- [The tyrants the Quran warns about](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/tyrants): The Quran warns of those who grew arrogant on the earth and were brought down: Pharaoh, Haman and Qarun.
- [Names from the rivers of Paradise](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/paradise-springs): The Quran names the springs and rivers of Paradise — Tasneem, Salsabil and Kawthar — and they became names for girls.
- [The command that comes right after faith](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/parents): Of everything the Quran asks of us, the one placed directly after worshipping Allah alone is kindness to your parents.
- [A single kasrah in a whole surah](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/one-kasrah): In all of Surah Al-Ikhlas there is only one kasrah — the vowel written beneath a letter — outside the basmalah: under the lam in “yalid”.
- [Thirty parts, sixty halves](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/thirty-parts): The Quran is divided into thirty parts so it can be finished in a month, and each part into two hizbs — sixty in all.
- [Six thousand two hundred and thirty-six](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/verse-count): By the count used in the copies we read today, the Quran has 6,236 verses.
- [Makki and Madani](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/makki-madani): The surahs divide into Makki and Madani: the familiar count is 86 revealed before the Hijrah and 28 after it — with a few surahs scholars place on either side.
- [The shortest word, and the heaviest](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/uff): The shortest word in the Quran that stands on its own is ﴿uff﴾ — and it is there to teach us not to show our parents even the smallest impatience.
- [A surah named after a fruit](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/at-teen): Surah At-Teen is named after a fruit — the fig — and it opens with an oath by it and by the olive.
- [A making after a making](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/science): The Quran describes the making of a human being in the womb one stage after another: a drop, then a clinging form, then a lump, then bones clothed in flesh — in an order the Quran itself sets out.
- [Fifteen surahs that open with an oath](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/oaths): Fifteen surahs open with an oath — Allah swearing by things He made, to make us look at them properly.
- [Endings that match what came before](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/verse-endings): Many verses close with two of Allah's names chosen to fit what the verse is about: the Forgiving, the Merciful where it speaks of repentance; the Almighty, the Wise where it speaks of might and victory.
- [The Quran's other names](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/quran-names): The Quran carries other names too: the Book, al-Furqan — the Criterion — the Light, and the Healing.
- [The first time it was gathered into one book](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/first-collection): The Quran was first gathered into a single book in the time of Abu Bakr as-Siddiq, on a suggestion from Umar ibn al-Khattab, so that it would be kept for everyone after them.
- [Three surahs that open by calling the believers](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/ya-ayyuha-alladhina-amanu): Only three surahs open with the call ﴿O you who have believed﴾: Al-Ma'idah, Al-Hujurat and Al-Mumtahanah.
- [Three surahs that call the Prophet ﷺ](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/ya-ayyuha-an-nabiyy): Three surahs open with a call meant for the Prophet ﷺ alone — ﴿O Prophet﴾: Al-Ahzab, At-Talaq and At-Tahrim.
- [The idols of Nuh's people](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/idols-of-nuh): The Quran names the idols Nuh's people worshipped — Wadd, Suwa', Yaghuth, Ya'uq and Nasr — so that we would keep well away from all of it.
- [Letters with no dots](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/dots-and-marks): The earliest copies had no dots on the letters and no vowel marks. Abu al-Aswad ad-Du'ali added the first marks for vowelling; then Nasr ibn Asim and Yahya ibn Ya'mar dotted the letters so a ba could be told from a ta; then Al-Khalil ibn Ahmad al-Farahidi developed the fatha, damma and kasra shapes we use today — so that everyone could read it correctly.
- [The copies Uthman sent out](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/uthman-mushaf): Caliph Uthman ibn Affan had copies made and sent to the Muslim cities, so that Muslims everywhere would gather around one and the same written text.
- [The scribes of the revelation](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/scribes-of-revelation): The Prophet ﷺ had companions who wrote the Quran down the moment it came — the scribes of the revelation. Among the best known was a young man named Zaid ibn Thabit.
- [A clue that tells you a surah is Makki](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/kalla-rule): Any surah containing the word kalla is Makki, revealed before the Hijrah — an easy clue that tells you where a surah belongs.
- [Animals to ride, and to enjoy](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/riding-animals): The Quran mentions horses, mules and donkeys — given to us both to ride and to delight in.
- [Locusts and frogs](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/locusts-and-frogs): Among the signs sent upon Pharaoh and his people were small creatures: the flood, the locusts, the lice and the frogs.
- [Surah An-Nur and the manners of a home](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/surah-an-nur-manners): Surah An-Nur teaches us the best manners for a home — among them asking permission before entering upon anyone.
- [The sea that split open](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/sea-that-split): Among the wonders the Quran tells of the sea: Allah split it for Musa, and each part of it stood like a great mountain.
- [Wait until you are welcomed in](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/asking-permission): The Quran teaches a fine manner: if you find no one home, do not go in until you are given permission.
- [Guard your tongue](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/guard-your-tongue): The Quran warns us away from suspicion, prying and backbiting, and asks us to keep our tongues for what is good.
- [Never lose hope](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/never-despair): However hard things become, the Quran teaches us never to lose hope in Allah's mercy and relief.
- [A healing for hearts](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/healing-for-hearts): The Quran is a true healing for a heart carrying sadness or worry, and a mercy for those who believe.
- [A light that shows the way](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/a-clear-light): Allah calls the Quran a clear light — it shows us the right way when everything around is dark.
- [Give its due on harvest day](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/give-on-harvest-day): The Quran tells us to give the poor and the needy their share, so that love spreads among people.
- [My Lord, increase me in knowledge](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/rabbi-zidni-ilma): The Quran urges us to keep seeking useful knowledge all our lives, and teaches us a prayer for more of it.
- [The owners of the garden](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/owners-of-the-garden): The Quran tells of the owners of an orchard who withheld from the poor and lost their fruit — a lesson that meanness wastes a blessing while giving makes it grow.
- [Three verses that hold the whole secret](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/surah-al-asr): Surah Al-Asr is only three verses, yet it holds the whole secret of success: faith, good deeds, and urging one another to truth and to patience.
- [Guide us to the straight path](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/straight-path): The Quran taught us to ask for guidance in every prayer — a prayer we say seventeen times a day.
- [Be fair even with someone you dislike](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/justice-even-with-those-we-dislike): The Quran asks us to be fair with everyone — even with people we disagree with, or simply do not like.
- [The Quran full of reminding](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/quran-as-reminder): Allah calls the Quran a reminder — it reminds anyone who wants to learn what is good and to live by it.
- [A garden as wide as the sky and the earth](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/paradise-as-wide-as): The Quran tells us the garden prepared for the God-fearing is as wide as the heavens and the earth, and invites us to hurry towards it.
- [Dhul-Qarnayn, the just king](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/dhul-qarnayn): The Quran tells of Dhul-Qarnayn, a king who travelled the earth spreading good and helping those who could not help themselves.
- [Help one another do good](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/cooperate-in-good): The Quran tells us to help one another in goodness, and warns us against helping one another in wrongdoing.
- [Luqman's advice to his son](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/luqman-advice): The Quran keeps for us the advice of wise Luqman to his son — and the first of it was never to associate anything with Allah.
- [Change starts inside us](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/change-begins-inside): The Quran tells us that Allah does not change the state of a people until they change what is inside themselves for the better.
- [Think about how the sky was made](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/reflect-on-creation): The Quran invites us to think about the making of the heavens and the earth, and the turning of night into day, and to see how great their Maker is.
- [With hardship comes ease](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/ease-after-hardship): Allah promises in the Quran that ease comes with every hardship — and says it twice, so that your heart would settle.
- [Ten recitations, all trusted](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/ten-recitations): The Quran came down in seven modes so every Arab tribe could recite it comfortably, and scholars have handed down ten trusted recitations we still read it by today.
- [Clear verses, and deeper ones](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/muhkam-mutashabih): Some verses are muhkam — plain to everyone, like what is allowed and what is not — and some are mutashabih, whose full meaning Allah kept with Himself.
- [Names taken from the Quran](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/names-from-the-quran): Many of our names come straight from words in the Quran: Daniya, Saja, Safwan, Marwa and Huda.
- [Its meanings are translated, not its words](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/translated-meanings): The meanings of the Quran have been translated into dozens of languages, but the Arabic text alone is the miraculous word of Allah; a translation only explains the meaning for those who do not read Arabic.
- [The verses of prostration](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/sajdah-verses): Some verses in the Quran are read and then you prostrate — the best known of them closes Surah Al-Alaq.
- [Nothing in it disagrees with itself](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/no-contradiction): One sign that the Quran is from Allah is that no part of it disagrees with another. Had it come from anyone else, they would have found much in it that clashed.
- [Among those who wrote down the revelation](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/four-caliphs-scribes): Historians of the Seerah list the four caliphs — Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman and Ali — among the scribes of revelation, and among the best known who wrote the Quran down before the Prophet ﷺ as it came was Zayd ibn Thabit.
- [A gathered list of manners](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/ten-commandments): The Quran gathers great advice on character in Surahs Al-An'am and Al-Isra, teaching us how to be of use to the people around us.
- [Exact arithmetic in Surah An-Nisa](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/inheritance-shares): The Quran sets out the shares of inheritance with exact arithmetic in Surah An-Nisa, so that no one in a family loses what is theirs.
- [It came down little by little](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/revealed-gradually): The Quran did not arrive all at once. It came slowly, over twenty-three years, to make it easier for people while they built their community and mended their habits.
- [Surahs that built a community](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/madani-society): The Madani surahs came to build a community: how to worship, how a family is ordered, how inheritance is shared, and what people owe one another.
- [Another clue for a Makki surah](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/muqattaat-makki): Every surah opening with the separated letters is Makki, except Al-Baqarah and Aal-Imran, which are Madani, and Ar-Ra'd, which scholars dispute — a rule that usually tells you when a surah came down.
- [Words that did not match hearts](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/hypocrites-exposed): The Madani surahs uncover those whose tongues said what their hearts did not hold — teaching us that being truthful with Allah comes first.
- [A word of ten letters](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/anulzimukumuha): The word ﴿anulzimukumuha﴾ in Surah Hud is among the longest in the Quran — ten letters in one word.
- [A question asked thirty-one times](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/ar-rahman-refrain): In Surah Ar-Rahman the question ﴿So which of your Lord's favours would you deny?﴾ returns thirty-one times, after every blessing named — so that we stop each time and give thanks.
- [One surah with two prostrations](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/two-prostrations-hajj): Surah Al-Hajj stands alone in having two prostrations — one near its start and one near its end — according to the Shafi'i and Hanbali schools.
- [The morning when it breathes](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/morning-that-breathes): Part of the beauty of the Quran is the living picture it draws: it speaks of the morning as if it takes a breath.
- [The first word: Read](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/first-revelation): The first of the Quran to come to the Prophet ﷺ, in the cave of Hira, was five verses of Surah Al-Alaq, beginning with ﴿Read﴾.
- [One of the Quran's longest words](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/longest-word): One of the longest words in the Quran is ﴿fa-asqaynakumuhu﴾ in Surah Al-Hijr — ten letters in the mushaf's script.
- [And We will surely guard it](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts/preserved-forever): Allah took upon Himself the guarding of the Quran from any change. It has stayed exactly as it came down, and remains a standing miracle through every age.

- [Discover the Quran](https://yahyaquran.com/quran-facts): one hundred short facts about the Quran
  for children — what it names, how it is arranged, and what is remarkable about
  it — presented as cards a child turns over one at a time.

## About and provenance
- [About the academy](https://yahyaquran.com/about): who built the site and why, in Arabic and English.
- The Quran text is the Uthmani script; the memorization journey plays
  verified teaching recitations, and highlighting is shown only where the
  timing data covers the ayah — nothing is inferred to fill a gap.
- Each Seerah story carries its own source reference on the page.
- Every page's full text is in the HTML that is served, so this site can be read
  without executing JavaScript.
